messages:
liam: FYI, we're seeing a 🚨 regresssion on prod: steady memory growth tied to KV cache when continuous batching is enabled. Started ~07:30 UTC and correlates with a spike in merge events.
anna: can you paste the top-line metrics? kv evict rate / contbatch merge rate / p99 latency?
liam: quick snapshot: kv_cache.evictions/sec = 0.12 -> 0.8 over 30m, contbatch.merge_rate = 420 -> 260 (per GPU), p99 token latency +18%
sara: hmm that looks like fragmentation + fewer successful merges -> head-of-line blocking. Did we change prefetch or quantization kernels in the last deploy?
liam: no kernel change in last deploy, but we shipped an aggressive prefetch heuristic + wider merge window (PR #4521). suspecting prefetch interacts poorly with long contexts.
matt: logged a repro harness into /infra/perf/harnesses/kv_repro_v2, can run with --longctx --cont-batching to repro locally.
liam: attached flamegraph from prod heap prof (trimmed): https://internal.corp/fg/3100000000/kv-heap.svg (large tail on kv slot objects)
anna: ok flamegraph shows a long tail of retained KVFragments, many have small sizes but high count — classic fragmentation.
sara: hypothesis: prefetching creates thin KV fragments across many slots, cont-batcher tries to merge batches but slot layout prevents coalescing -> merges fail and HOL waiting increases.
liam: timeline: before PR 4521, contbatch.merge_success ~ 94%. after PR it dropped to 61%. that matches.
matt: ran local with config: --prefetch-window=64 --merge-window-ms=6. reproduce steps: \n```
./perf_harness --model t5-xxl --sim-load 0.8 --longctx --cont-batching --prefetch-window=64 --merge-window-ms=6 > out.log
```
logs show repeated "merge_abort: slot_mismatch" and long HOL wait: hol_wait_ms ~ 12ms
anna: good repro. can you collect kvstats heatmap? contbatch slot occupancy per sequence length?
matt: uploading kvstats: https://internal.corp/artifacts/3100000000/kvstats.json (small sample). Distribution skewed: lots of 8-16 token fragments occupying unique slots.
sara: quick mitigation: revert prefetch heuristic and tighten merge-window to prefer smaller latency first. If that reduces fragmentation, we know it's interaction not kernel.
liam: agreed. also want to try the alternative: keep prefetch but serialize prefetch on a per-slot basis (avoid creating many tiny fragments). which is lower risk?
anna: revert PR 4521 as canary immediately, but also run experiments: 1) prefetch=off, 2) prefetch=on + slot-serialize, 3) merge-window-ms=3. Run A/B on one dedicated pool.
liam: I'll patch rollback now + enqueue experiments. Will monitor kv.fragmentation_ratio, contbatch.merge_success, hol_wait_ms, mem_retention_bytes.
dev-bot: deploy started: rollback/4521 -> prod-dedicated-pool-3 (job 8272). ETA ~4m :rocket:
matt: note for postmortem: add unit test that simulates interleaved prefetch + merge to catch regressions.
sara: if rollback doesn't reduce eviction spike within 15m, we escalate to runtime oncall.
anna: assigning follow-ups: liam (run post-rollback metrics + A/B), matt (add sim test + collect more kvstats), sara (design slot-serialize change). deadline EOD.
liam: thanks — will update thread with metrics. :thumbsup:
